structured_output.explanation: The active correction says every non-alphanumeric UTF-16 code unit becomes a dash, with no NFC normalization. encode_project does exactly that, and it doesn't normalize. The fallback decoder handles UNC, drive-letter and posix prefixes, as the correction describes. The old plan is only a future proposal, so its NFC and decode details aren't active.
